field_checks.summary: The mechanism ontology keeps evidence classes distinct in count, but mechanism_claims[0] is not publication-grade because its direct_mechanism source_locator list conflates true SEM/TEM evidence with toxicity-method and biofilm OD575 surfaces.

Paper identity is source-resolved to RSC Advances 2025, DOI 10.1039/d5ra02745d, PMID 40510052, PMCID PMC12160004; A3/D-A3 share the source one-letter sequence CRRWRRRRC and no final object contains both sequence and sequence_length needing correction.

Activity/database numeric normalization checks passed and source_locator/source_locators values do not contain recursive artifact paths, but locator integrity fails because the direct mechanism claim uses non-direct toxicity and biofilm locators as supporting source_locator values.

Recursive authority is not used for source_locator/source_locators fields, all six worker logs are gpt-5.5 xhigh with zero return codes, strict gates rerun cleanly, and fallback DBAASP machine rows remain excluded from authoritative ingest.

No primary-source value conflict was found in Table 1/2 activity rows, but the final cautions correctly preserve absent authoritative database links, modified triazole identities without plain sequence normalization, approximate Supplement Fig. S13 values, and non-promoted zebrafish graph quantitation.

The single staged supplementary PDF is readable and represented by 17 text/OCR page records, rendered page review artifacts, 25 figure surfaces, no structured supplementary tables, no archives, and no unrecoverable material gaps.

Final toxicity coverage includes five hemolysis threshold rows, four text-bound zebrafish hatching rows, and two qualitative Fig. 11f body-length rows; exact graph-derived hemolysis and zebrafish bar values are deliberately not promoted and remain a preserved caution rather than a separate blocker.
